result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues make the restaurant discovery UI look broken: category pills and restaurant cards are cut off, names overflow, and horizontal carousels clip content without clear affordances.

issues.description: The category filter row is cut off on the right; only a sliver of the next pill is visible after 'Healthy', with no clear indication of more options or proper scrolling affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll works with peek padding, show a partial next chip intentionally, or wrap/add a 'More' control so filters are not abruptly clipped.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you', the third restaurant card (Trattoria Picco...) is heavily truncated—both the image and the name are cut mid-word at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Give carousel items consistent width with right padding so the last visible card peeks cleanly, and ensure titles use ellipsis or two-line clamp instead of hard clipping.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word with no ellipsis treatment, making the label look broken and hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis (or equivalent) with a max width, or allow a second line so names remain legible.

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, so the offer appears incomplete on first view.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so cards are fully visible before scrolling.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit overlapping the food images with uneven placement and strong white pills that can obscure dish imagery.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge position and size, and ensure sufficient margin from card edges so images remain clear.
